costs.embedding_producer: Separate root producer charged once; existing vectors reused, no scorer or per-cap charge.

limitations: The grid is repeated weighting of14 underlying semantic judgments, not1344 independent judgments; Neel has2 target source groups and Chris1.
Richer fit adds approved text within existing fit families (Neel1/Chris2); it does not establish benefit from independent new writing families.
The corpus comparison has one extraction per config/researcher and separate request times; stochastic extraction and service failures remain part of observed operational delivery.
Conditional/joint-valid comparison is selected by availability and does not replace the all-planned estimand.
Two uncertain calls,20 never-called partial tails and one14-slot unknown-collision job remain missing; no retry or hold removal.

Semantic reversal can change retrieved context; lexical and semantic order comparisons have different causal scope. Existing role05 order diagnostic records14 semantic context changes across84 source-condition/cap comparisons.
P7 uses declared peer fitting evidence; source families and target bindings remain unchanged.
High no-profile/name-only accuracy limits task discrimination; personal profile benefit is not established merely by good conditional accuracy.
No final-test, winner, promotion, or source/human-population conclusion.
question: Does more approved fitting text improve delivery and choice fidelity on the same frozen targets?
